purpose: Resolve a concrete contract-selection ambiguity in the original fixed-December-contract coverage audit, not change strategy returns.
trigger_and_inspection: The original NESZ6 September screen showed 604 missing regular slots, 602 before September 14. MESZ6 was also a deferred contract early in the month. This is an explicitly post-hoc follow-up; keep the original audit unchanged. September-expiry price bars have not been retrieved when this specification is frozen.
source_rule: CME equity roll date is the Monday prior to the third Friday; official September 2026 roll date is September 14, expiration September 18. Participants can roll at other times; this is a fixed convention, not a claim about the maximum-volume contract every minute.
new_data: Massive /futures/v1/aggs/NESU6 and MESU6; resolution 5min, window_start.gte 2026-09-01, window_start.lt 2026-09-14, limit 50000, sort window_start.asc. Preserve all pages and reject unresolved pagination.
prior_data: Reuse frozen NESZ6 and MESZ6 September CSVs from H3; do not change or overwrite them.
calendar: Use the same 21 full US equity regular sessions and 78 five-minute slots per session as the original H3 nano gate. No weekend, Labor Day or overnight slots in the coverage denominator.
metrics: Present/missing regular slots by day and month
Longest missing run in each daily 09:30-16:00 window
Counts of present bars with volume below 10 or transactions at most 3
method: Select the dated contract by the fixed calendar before looking up each slot. No future-volume contract choice, price back-adjustment, forward fill or synthetic traded price. Do not calculate returns across the switch.
interpretation: A reduction in missing slots would indicate that the earlier fixed-December-contract result cannot stand in for customary nearby-contract coverage. It would not prove spreads, executable depth, fill probability or broker eligibility.
performance_or_capital_claim: None. This is a data-coverage audit only; no funded account, PnL or annual return is computed.
